subject: SIG intake: control mapping, log transfer, and evidence timeline
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nebulatech.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nebulatech.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 17:00:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake and initial asks

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this — Nebula is ready to kick off the SIG/CAIQ intake for our prospective deployment. A couple of asks ahead of the call so we can make the first meeting productive: 

- Can you share a short CAIQ summary and a list of recommended sample log types (auth/login, request traces, admin actions) and the preferred format (CSV/JSON)?
- We will need a window for transferring 7 days of high-fidelity logs (approx 12GB compressed). Do you support SFTP or a temporary signed URL for pulls?
- Proposed times for a 45m intake call next week (PST): Tue 5/25 10:00–10:45, Wed 5/26 13:00–13:45, or Thu 5/27 09:00–09:45.

If you can attach the intake checklist and any evidence matrix you typically use, that would help our security and procurement teams. We are aiming to complete the intake and an initial gap map within two weeks.

Regards,
Alex Rivera
Security Engineering Lead
Nebula Therapeutics

Attachment request: sample-logs-manifest.csv (placeholder)
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nebulatech.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nebulatech.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake and initial asks

Hi Alex — great to meet you virtually. Thanks for the clear list. We can cover everything on the intake call and I’ve attached a short CAIQ summary and our intake checklist to this message.

Quick answers:
- CAIQ summary: attached (redwood_caiq-summary.pdf). The full CAIQ will be available during the intake.
- Log transfer: SFTP is preferred for bulk pulls; we can also provide time-limited signed URLs for one-off grabs. I created a temporary SFTP path and included it in related links; we’ll provision a read-only account for your team for the transfer window.
- Sample logs: we typically request auth events, API request/response traces with headers (anonymized), and admin audit events. A one-week slice is helpful for initial sampling — template attached (sample-logs-manifest.csv).

I can take Tue 5/25 10:00 PST — booking that slot tentatively. Marissa, can you join to cover evidence mapping and owners? David, can you confirm the ops ETA on provisioning the SFTP read-only account?

Action items before call:
- Redwood: attach CAIQ summary and intake checklist (done)
- Redwood ops: provision SFTP read-only account and confirm credentials (David)
- Nebula: confirm sample log availability and preferred transfer window (Alex/Samir)

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_caiq-summary.pdf, intake-checklist.xlsx
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Nebula SIG intake — owners and prep (please read)

Marissa / David — forwarding Alex’s request and my reply. Please see the quick plan below; call is tentatively Tue 5/25 10:00 PST.

What I need:
- Marissa: lead the control mapping conversation and own the evidence matrix deliverable. I’ll ask Nebula for their top-20 CAIQ questions to prioritize. Draft owner: Marissa Cole (CS lead). Target: share initial gap map within 5 business days after the call.
- David: ops to provision SFTP read-only account and upload credentials to our secure share. Target: credentials to me by EOD Mon 5/24 so Nebula can test. Also confirm we can accept a 12GB compressed transfer and provide recommended chunking approach.
- Me: run intake, capture meeting notes, and assemble initial evidence list. I’ll attach the CAIQ summary + intake checklist (attached to external reply) and create the HubSpot intake record.

Please reply with any blockers. I’ll add an agenda for the intake call (15m intro, 20m CAIQ prioritization, 10m logs/transfer cadence) to the calendar invite.

Quoted for context:

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nebulatech.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nebulatech.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake and initial asks — confirmation and post-call notes

Soojin / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and for provisioning the materials. Confirming the Tue 5/25 10:00 PST slot works for us (calendar invite accepted). A couple of quick follow-ups from our side after the prep review:

1) We reviewed redwood_caiq-summary.pdf and the intake checklist — looks good.
2) We’ll do SFTP. Please send the test credentials by EOD Mon 5/24. We’ll push a 200MB test archive and confirm integrity.
3) On the call we recorded the following action items & owners: 
   - Redwood to provide the top-25 prioritized CAIQ questions for mapping (Marissa) — due 5/28
   - Nebula to provide sample-logs (one-week compressed) via SFTP test transfer (Alex/Samir) — test by 5/24, full transfer after acceptance window
   - Redwood ops to share recommended chunking and an SCP-based fallback (David) — due 5/24
   - Both teams to align on retention and redaction expectations — follow-up thread after gap map

HubSpot: I dropped a note on the deal (HB-2027-1147) and linked the intake folder.

Thanks again — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Security Engineering Lead
Nebula Therapeutics

Attachments referenced: sample-logs-manifest.csv
